verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own Batch Processing API for high-volume processing, and asynchronous screening for high-volume scenarios, so bulk customer creation and screening is a first-party capability. However, the evidence is a single-line pointer with no detail on batch size, job status or results handling. Nothing shows bulk actions on other items such as cases, alerts or risk decisions. Missing for 10: documented batch API details (limits, job tracking, result retrieval), bulk operations on cases/alerts/decisions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
